name: Full Webapp Audit
description: Check my full webapp for errors and give me suggestions. I want a comprehensive audit of the entire PEN News Portal codebase — looking for bugs, broken logic, missing features, performance issues, security vulnerabilities, and UI/UX inconsistencies across all admin and frontend pages, controllers, models, views, routes, and JS/CSS assets.

goal.answer: Perform a comprehensive error-check and improvement audit of the entire PEN News Portal Laravel application, covering all controllers, models, views, routes, migrations, and configuration. Deliver a detailed findings report with prioritized fixes and enhancement suggestions.

criteria.answer:
A consolidated markdown audit report exists at `.kimchi/docs/audit-report.md` with 20+ findings categorized by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and domain (Security, Bug, Performance, UX, Code Quality).
Every controller (28 files) and model (17 files) has been read and checked for logic errors, auth gaps, N+1 queries, and mass-assignment risks.
All Blade views (77 files) have been checked for XSS risks, missing CSRF tokens, broken markup, and dark-mode inconsistencies.
Routes and migrations audited for missing middleware, missing indexes, and missing constraints.
Application boots cleanly (`php artisan route:list` exits 0).

constraints.answer: Do not modify application code — this is analysis-only., Focus on practical, actionable findings., Prioritize security, data integrity, and user-facing bugs over code style.

phases.answer: Parallel Domain Audits, Report Compilation & Verification

assumptions.answer: The codebase is a Laravel 12.x + PHP 8.2 application using MySQL via XAMPP.; No new dependencies should be introduced as part of this audit.; User wants report-only; no fixes to be applied.

phases.name: Parallel Domain Audits
phases.goal: Systematically read and analyze all code files across backend, frontend, and infrastructure to identify security, bug, performance, and UX issues.
phases.description: Run three independent audit probes in parallel: Backend (controllers + models), Frontend (Blade + JS + CSS), and Infrastructure (routes + migrations + config). Each probe writes findings to a separate markdown file.

steps.description: Backend audit: read all controllers and models, check mass assignment, auth, SQL injection, N+1 queries

result.stdout: test -s /mnt/c/xampp/htdocs/ProDo/penews/.kimchi/docs/audit-backend.md && echo "PASS - audit-backend.md exists and is non-empty"

steps.description: Frontend audit: read all Blade views, JS, CSS; check XSS, CSRF, dark mode, accessibility

result.stdout: test -s /mnt/c/xampp/htdocs/ProDo/penews/.kimchi/docs/audit-frontend.md && echo "PASS - audit-frontend.md exists and is non-empty"

steps.description: Infrastructure audit: read routes, migrations, .env, config; check middleware, indexes, constraints

result.stdout: test -s /mnt/c/xampp/htdocs/ProDo/penews/.kimchi/docs/audit-infra.md && echo "PASS - audit-infra.md exists and is non-empty"

phases.summary: All three domain audits (Backend, Frontend, Infrastructure) completed successfully. Backend audit found 14 issues, Frontend found 19, Infrastructure found 13. Reports are written to .kimchi/docs/audit-{backend,frontend,infra}.md.

phases.name: Report Compilation & Verification
phases.goal: Deliver a professional, actionable audit report that the user can use to prioritize fixes.
phases.description: Combine all three domain audit reports into a single consolidated report with executive summary, severity matrix, priority fix matrix, and appendix. Verify the report meets the success criteria and the application boots cleanly.

steps.description: Write consolidated audit-report.md combining all findings

result.stdout: wc -l /mnt/c/xampp/htdocs/ProDo/penews/.kimchi/docs/audit-report.md && test -s /mnt/c/xampp/htdocs/ProDo/penews/.kimchi/docs/audit-report.md && echo "PASS - report exists with $(wc -l < /mnt/c/xampp/htdocs/ProDo/penews/.kimchi/docs/audit-report.md) lines"
cd /mnt/c/xampp/htdocs/ProDo/penews && /mnt/c/xampp/php/php.exe artisan route:list > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "PASS - route:list exits 0" || echo "FAIL - route:list failed"

phases.summary: Phase 2 completed. Consolidated audit report written (46 findings across Critical/High/Medium/Low). Application boots cleanly with route:list exiting 0.

grade.rationale: Phase 1 F1 explicitly relied on proxy file-existence checks, Phase 2 F1 used proxy file-size validation for the report artifact, and the trail notes a backend agent abort was manually compensated rather than completing cleanly on the first pass. The audit goal appears fully met, but the weak verification and delivery turbulence fall short of the strict, concrete, retry-free standard required for an A.
